description: This source file defines a static utility class 'CorrelationIdGenerator' that generates unique correlation IDs using a base32 encoding scheme. The IDs are based on an incrementing counter seeded with the current UTC time in ticks, suitable for identifying correlations in network communications.

classes.name: CorrelationIdGenerator
classes.description: A static class responsible for generating unique correlation IDs in a thread-safe manner using base32 encoding.

methods.name: GetNextId
methods.description: Returns the next unique correlation ID as a string by incrementing the internal counter atomically.

methods.name: GenerateId
methods.description: Generates a base32 encoded ID string of length 13 based on the provided long value.
